interpretation_boundary: Official cell-eval DE-type metrics are NOT numerically interchangeable with the framework-internal DES/PDS/MAE reported in §3.3. This ceiling bounds the official DE-type metrics under the noise of the REAL data only. It is descriptive, model-free, and is NOT used to adjudicate H1/H2/H3, to re-scale any model score, or to change any preregistered criterion.

compliance.reason_no_update: The registered dataset set, model set, metrics, thresholds, fold count and seeds are unchanged. The cell subsample is a memory-constrained implementation detail WITHIN one already registered dataset, disclosed with seed and hashes in the manuscript Methods; it produces no model score and no hypothesis conclusion.
